NOTIFICATION NO: 23/MRB/2025 DATE: 10.01.2026
NOTICE
Medical Services Recruitment Board had published Notification for Special
Qualifying Examination for persons appointed temporarily as Assistant
Surgeon vide NOTIFICATION NO: 23/MRB/2025 Dated: 24.12.2025. The
Computer Based Test for Special Qualifying Examination for persons
appointed temporarily as Assistant Surgeon is scheduled to be held on 31st
January 2026 (Saturday) in single session.
Timing:
Tamil Eligibility Test : 09.00 AM to 10.00 AM
Subject Paper : 10.15 AM to 12.15 PM
MEMBER SECRETARY
